text.text_excerpt: Mambo's. A delightful restaurant on Bourbon St. with a rooftop bar. Besides the full bar, this place has bomb food. Everything ordered was relatively good, but my favorite dish was the carnival pasta! It had such amazing flavors that weren't too overwhelming and great texture. My second favorite dish ordered worth mentioning is the BBQ Shrimp. The shrimp was fresh and nicely cooked (not overly cooked/chewy). The sauce it came with was delicious. I originally ordered it because I thought it was gonna come with grits but it didn't. My mistake. Lastly, the bread pudding was the perfect ending to the meal! Hot, sweet, delicious! The crab cakes and chargrilled oysters were okay. One thing wort...

Dang! Awesomeness again on Bourbon Street. Go to Mambos. Ask for "Jasmin in Action " as your server. Outstanding oysters, beer selection and a great meal. I had the redfish with the greens. Outstanding both. The redfish also had shrimp and crabmeat and was the special...great decision! Bread pudding was also delicious ending. Impressed.

This place is a prime location because it's located on the bustling and busy Bourbon St. You can see parades pass by here from inside. They boasted about their rooftop bar area but when I came (they say it's the only and first roof top bar on the street), they said it wasn't open. I tried the burger, fries, red fish with collared greens and grits. My mom thought the grits were too buttery and greasy. The collared greens were too salty. We got a free dessert with Yelp check-in. I'm adding an extra star to the review because of that! I also tried a dozen raw oysters for $18. Several had mussels stuck on the outside of them. It came with a horseradish and cocktail sauce.
